name: tomato-root
description: Root project control for Tomato microservices and frontend

scripts.install:all: concurrently -n auth,restaurant,utilitis,frontend -c "cyan,green,magenta,yellow" "npm run install:auth" "npm run install:restaurant" "npm run install:utilitis" "npm run install:frontend"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -n auth,restaurant,utilitis -c "cyan,green,magenta" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:restaurant" "npm run dev:utilitis"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n auth,restaurant,utilitis,frontend -c "cyan,green,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:restaurant" "npm run dev:utilitis" "npm run dev:frontend"
